description: This file defines the NoteRepository class, which provides data access methods for Note objects in a Flutter application, interfacing with a local database via DatabaseHelper.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Provides methods for CRUD operations and search functionality on notes stored in a database.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the database, ordered with pinned notes first and most recently updated first.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches for notes in the database where title or content matches the query string.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns the inserted note with its new ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database by its ID.

methods.name: togglePin
methods.description: Toggles the pinned status of a note and updates the timestamp.
